title: Mistral AI raises €3 billion in response to doubts over its strategic direction

title: Thousands of 'Greater Serbia' supporters attend funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade

In this French city, social diversity in schools has almost disappeared
subhed: According to studies, the southern city of Perpignan is the most educationally segregated in France. It's divided between private schools, which rank among the most privileged in the country, and public schools, which, in almost every case, sit at the exact opposite end of the social scale.

title: 'China will not replace the United States as a global power'
subhed: Dan Wang, a Chinese-Canadian researcher living in the US, has devoted his latest book, 'Breakneck: China's Quest to Engineer the Future,' to the two rival powers. In an interview with Le Monde, he discussed what sets them apart, but also what brings them together.

title: Unprecedented drop in French students' performance echoes worldwide decline
subhed: Reading and maths scores for 15-year-olds in France have fallen to their lowest levels since 2000, mirroring trends seen in comparable countries. Among the reasons cited to explain this global phenomenon are attitudes toward learning, the role of digital technology, the lasting effects of the Covid-19 crisis and a lack of parental involvement. In France, significant social and gender inequalities persist.
